decisions.reason: The page-builder and migration clarification does not change the Legacy site's page-speed objective.
The source does not change the requirement to preserve the Legacy site's fonts and formatting.
The Thrive and Elementor decision has no effect on whether comments remain disabled.
The source does not alter Wordfence scanning targets, automation, or security purpose.
Using Elementor for replacement-site pages does not modify the deferred HLX page-speed objective or its lifecycle.
The page-builder migration decision does not change the completed credential-rotation targets.
The source does not change the URLs targeted for removal or the Search Console removal method.
Clarifying Thrive usage and future page migration does not change the existing malware-remediation requirement.
The source does not alter which administrator accounts are authorized or subject to removal.
The page-builder decision does not change the rule for deleting malware-generated content.

The source confirms that Thrive is used on the current site and absent from the replacement site, but it does not resolve whether the vulnerable installation should be updated, retained temporarily, or removed; propagation requires a further remediation decision.
The source does not modify the performance findings or before-and-after reporting obligation.
